title: Make echoes each command before running it
objective: Watch make print a recipe line before running it, and keep one line out of that echo with @.
hint: make writes every recipe line to stdout and then runs it, so you see the command and its output. An @ at the start of a line stops the printing for that line only; the command still runs.

steps.description: the silent line's output appears without its command
steps.stdout:
this line runs, but make does not print it
echo "make prints this line before running it"
make prints this line before running it
echo "this line runs, but make does not print it"
